description: The plot illustrates how DPR performance (MRR@10) on the MS-Marco dev set varies with the number of queries used during inference (S), comparing a no-query baseline against three expansion variants. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S).” and is on a linear scale spanning integer values from 1 to 10, with labeled ticks shown at 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with regularly spaced tick labels every 0.5. Four lines are shown: a black solid horizontal line (“DPR w/o query”) that stays constant at approximately 34.25 across all S values; a red solid line with circular markers (“DPR w/ corpus expansion”) that rises from about 35.15 at S=1 to about 35.55 at S=2 and then stays in a narrow band, reaching about 35.79 at S=7 and ending around 35.78 at S=10; a green solid line with upward triangle markers (“DPR w/ document expansion”) that remains nearly flat, starting near 34.78 at S=1, hovering around 34.86–34.92 through the middle (about 34.92 at S=6), and ending near 34.84 at S=10; and a blue solid line with star markers (“DPR w/ asymmetric expansion”) that fluctuates, starting near 34.75 at S=1, reaching about 35.00 at S=2, dropping to about 34.70 at S=3, returning to about 35.00 at S=5, and then trending downward to approximately 34.35 by S=10.
